name: gdrive_mount
title: Google Drive (mounted folder)
description: A folder of your Google Drive, used through Google Drive for desktop: rows are read and written in the Drive folder on this computer, and Drive keeps it in sync. Same folders as the Google Drive (API) driver.

path.label: Folder
path.hint: A folder in My Drive, by its path. Made on first use.

account.label: Google account
account.hint: Which signed-in Drive to use when Drive for desktop has several accounts.

mount_root.label: My Drive folder
mount_root.hint: Where My Drive is on this computer. Found by itself; set only when it is somewhere unusual.

setup_wizards.label: Set up Google Drive on this computer
